title: Objects on radar and seen by airmen over Malmstrom

tellings.quote: And in the meantime, there are reports at Malmstrom Air Force Base. Objects are seen on radar. Objects are seen by airmen at the base.

plain: Robert Salas, a former US Air Force officer, says that on 24 March 1967 there were reports at Malmstrom Air Force Base in Montana of objects showing up on radar and being seen by airmen at the base, a detail he links to a man named Lewis Chase. Salas tells it as part of his larger account of a UFO that, he says, shut down ten nuclear missiles that same period.
